clagentic-lite PR template.

This governs PRs opened through the GitHub web UI. A PR opened by
`clagentic-lite gates ship` renders an equivalent body automatically
(scripts/gates.sh, _build_ship_pr_body) from what the tool actually
recorded for this branch — see docs/GATES.md "Ship-time PR body" for the
degrade-honestly rules that render follows. Fill in every section below by
hand for a manually-opened PR; if a section genuinely does not apply, say
so explicitly rather than leaving it blank.
-->

## What changed and why

<!-- The change, and the reason for it. Not a commit-message paraphrase. -->

## Review provenance

<!--
What each review pass found, and specifically what changed as a result. A
verdict alone ("clean" / "approved") is not enough — the finding-plus-
consequence is what a skeptical reader needs. If no review ran, say that
plainly: "reviewer: none" is honest; a confident-looking empty section is
not.
-->

## Trade-offs taken and rejected

<!--
Alternatives considered and why this one won. If none were seriously
considered, say "none — first workable approach" rather than leaving this
blank.
-->

## Explicitly out of scope

<!--
What this PR deliberately does not address, so a reviewer doesn't wonder
whether it was missed. "None" is a valid answer if the change is fully
